description: LLD - Linepack Data - Open is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. Gas starts at one end of our network and ends at the gas meter of each of our customers. The Linepack dataset looks at the forecasted demand from when gas enters our network to when it is used. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operational, Open. Its keywords are Linepack. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence 3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
